latHint: Think something draped over the shoulders - not gift paper.
pivHint: You WRAP a present in paper - but a WRAP worn around the shoulders is also called a ______.
winText: Cozy cover. WRAP was the pivot - gift paper to a SHAWL around the shoulders.
lossText: SHAWL - a loose cloth worn over the shoulders. WRAP was the pivot: gift WRAP to a shoulder WRAP.
